name: Cucumber-mint water
blurb: The house cooler — two cooling ingredients and nothing to argue about.
steps: Slice half a cucumber thin; tear a small handful of mint.
Drop both into a jug of cold water with a squeeze of lime.
Rest 20 minutes in the fridge before drinking.

name: Sattu cooler
blurb: Bihar's summer answer — filling enough to replace a meal in the heat.
steps: Whisk 3 tbsp roasted gram flour into a glass of cold water until smooth.
Add lemon juice, a pinch of roasted cumin and salt to taste.
Drink immediately, before it settles.

name: Barley water
blurb: The old Unani cooler, still handed out for summer heat.
steps: Simmer 2 tbsp pearl barley in 4 cups water for 30 minutes.
Strain, and stir in lemon and a little honey while warm.
Chill and drink through the day.

name: Mint lassi
blurb: Salted, not sweet — the version that actually cools.
steps: Blend a cup of yogurt with a cup of cold water until frothy.
Add torn mint, roasted cumin and salt.
Serve over ice.

name: Ginger-honey tea
blurb: The warming standby when hands and feet won't heat up.
steps: Simmer a thumb of sliced ginger in 2 cups water for 10 minutes.
Take off the heat, then add honey and lemon.
Sip hot.

name: Golden milk
blurb: Haldi doodh — the warming bedtime cup of every desi household.
steps: Warm a cup of milk with ½ tsp turmeric and a crack of black pepper.
Add a small spoon of ghee and a little jaggery if you want it sweet.
Drink warm, before bed.

name: Cinnamon-date warmer
blurb: Caffeine-free, warming, and sweet without sugar.
steps: Simmer 3 pitted dates with a cinnamon stick and a cracked cardamom pod in milk.
Once the dates soften, blend smooth.
Drink hot.

name: Plain rice with ghee
blurb: The reset meal for a reactive day — nothing aged, nothing fermented.
steps: Cook white rice fresh — not yesterday's, not reheated twice.
Stir in a spoon of ghee and a pinch of salt while hot.
Eat it warm, on its own.

name: Fresh oat porridge
blurb: A low-histamine breakfast that doesn't rely on anything cultured.
steps: Cook oats in water or fresh milk.
Grate in half an apple and a little cinnamon near the end.
Eat straight away — leftovers are the whole problem.

name: Coconut-chia cooler
blurb: Hydrating, cooling, and clean on the SIGHI list.
steps: Stir 1 tbsp chia seeds into a glass of coconut water.
Leave 15 minutes until the seeds swell.
Add a squeeze of lime and drink cold.
